zara.engineer: Hey @people-ops quick Q — I bought a 3-day coworking daypass while traveling for a customer visit. Kept the PDF/QR receipts. Can I expense the daypass and still claim per-diem?

olivia.peopleops: Short answer: yes, the coworking daypass is reimbursable if it’s business-related and pre-approved. We need the vendor receipt/QR + a short note on which days were business. Per-diem rules still apply but you can’t double-dip for meals included in the daypass. :white_check_mark:

sam.finance: Finance addendum — upload the PDF/QR and the card statement line. If the daypass includes VAT and vendor tax info, attach that so we can attempt VAT reclaim. Put category = Travel > Lodging/Workspace.

zara.engineer: Thx. Small wrinkle: I extended the trip 1 personal day on the weekend and used the same pass that third day. How do I split?

olivia.peopleops: For mixed-use purchases, submit a pro-rata claim. In the expense form, show the breakdown (business days vs personal day) and attach a brief note + calendar screenshot. Example line in notes: "3-day pass (2 business days, 1 personal day) — reimburse 2/3". Manager approval required for the split.

sam.finance: If vendor provides no itemized invoice and it’s a single charge, we accept the pro-rata explanation but need an approval thread or manager sign-off in the expense. If company card was used, flag it — we’ll reconcile. If you used personal card, submit as usual.

zara.engineer: What if I lost the QR/receipt? I only have the booking confirmation email and my bank statement.

olivia.peopleops: If the original QR is lost, we accept a provider confirmation email + bank statement showing the charge. Include any user account purchase history screenshot. Put "missing receipt" in the notes and tag your manager.

sam.finance: Also acceptable: a short emailed statement from the coworking vendor confirming dates and amount. We try to avoid manual exceptions, but this is ok for small amounts (< $200). For > $200 we may ask for extra verification.

expense-bot: Reminder: please tag cost_center and project_code on the expense or the submit will be routed back. Use the Travel template.

zara.engineer: Got it. One more — does the company reimburse memberships (e.g., monthly coworking membership) when purchased specifically for a trip?

olivia.peopleops: Monthly memberships generally aren’t covered unless pre-approved as a one-off for a customer program. If it’s short-term and directly tied to a project, submit a PO/approval before purchase. Retro approvals are rare.

sam.finance: If pre-approved, we require a pro-rated reimbursement for the travel period only (show dates). Membership = reimbursable only with documented business justification and manager + finance pre-approval.

zara.engineer: Thanks both — I’ll upload receipts and the calendar breakdown now.

olivia.peopleops: Perfect — ping me if you need manager approver email.

sam.finance: FYI: sample notes block you can paste into expenses:
```
Business daypass reimbursement:
- 2025-03-12: business ($30)
- 2025-03-13: business ($30)
- 2025-03-14: personal ($30) — not reimbursed
Reason: customer on-site workshops on 12-13. Manager: @alex.product approved 2025-02-28.
```

zara.engineer: pasted and submitted. Thanks! :raised_hands:
